acceptance.description: Extend coordination evidence compatibly with a reproducible observable result
acceptance.evidence_oracle: A legacy handoff remains valid. Positive data, code and evaluation handoffs are parsed. A wrong digest, unknown revision or missing evidence yields a blocked claim and a specific next action. A schema-valid envelope alone cannot mark a task accepted.

tasks.title: Measure route choice and downstream behavior separately

acceptance.description: Measure route choice and downstream behavior separately with a reproducible observable result
acceptance.evidence_oracle: For ranked IDs X,Y with only Y relevant, reciprocal rank is 0.5. Empty permitted corpus yields the specified no-route result. A correct top route followed by an incorrect output counts as a routing success and execution failure, with denominators recorded. Deduplicating query families changes the denominator explicitly. The report never converts a retrieval proxy into a live execution pass.

tasks.title: Coordinate a bounded AI-built change and preserve recovery evidence

acceptance.description: Coordinate a bounded AI-built change and preserve recovery evidence with a reproducible observable result
acceptance.evidence_oracle: A stopped handoff resumes without accepting a stale test receipt, writing twice or broadening permissions. An unavailable specialist leaves its result NOT_ASSESSED while independent tasks proceed. Legacy coordination remains valid.

acceptance.evidence_oracle: The classifier journey reaches the documented prediction and outcome checks. The coding journey catches the bad patch through K3. Missing provider evidence stays missing.
